Name: Crop Planting Reminder
Author: mahsouto
Description:
[size=6][b]Crop Planting Reminder[/b][/size]
[b]Never miss an empty farmland tile again![/b] This mod shows visual reminders (floating bubbles) over tilled soil that needs seeds planted, helping you maximize your farm efficiency.

[size=5][b][center]Features[/center]
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Visual Notifications[/b]: Floating bubbles with seed icons appear over empty tilled soil
[*][b]Sprinkler Integration[/b]: Option to show reminders only within sprinkler coverage areas
[*][b]Customizable Icons[/b]: Choose from 10 different seed/farming icons for the bubbles
[*][b]Full Sprinkler Support[/b]: Works with Basic, Quality, Iridium, and Prismatic sprinklers
[*][b]Flexible Controls[/b]: Works automatically or with hotkey activation
[*][b]Performance Optimized[/b]: Smart caching system for smooth gameplay
[*][b]Multilingual[/b]: Supports English, Spanish, French, and Korean
[/list]

[size=5][b][center]How It Works[/center]
[/b][/size]
[b]Default Behavior:[/b]
[list]
[*]Shows reminder bubbles on ALL tilled soil that needs planting
[*]Works automatically without pressing any keys
[*]Uses turnip seed icon by default
[/list]
[b]Sprinkler Mode:[/b]
[list]
[*]Enable "Sprinkler Range Only" to show reminders only within sprinkler coverage
[*]Automatically detects all sprinkler types and their patterns
[*]Perfect for organized irrigation systems
[/list]
[center]
[size=5][b]Configuration Options[/b][/size][/center]
Access settings through [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b]:
[b]Core Settings:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Mod Enabled[/b]: Turn the mod on/off
[*][b]Sprinkler Range Only[/b]: Limit reminders to sprinkler coverage areas
[*][b]Require Key Press[/b]: Only show reminders when hotkey is held
[*][b]Press Keys[/b]: Configure hotkey (if enabled)
[/list]
[b]Visual Customization:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Bubble Icon[/b]: Choose from 10 different icons:
 [list]
[*]Turnip Seeds (default) 
[*]Parsnip Seeds 
[*]Cauliflower Seeds 
[*]Potato Seeds 
[*]Tulip Bulb 
[*]Jazz Bulb 
[*]Fertilizer 
[*]Grass Starter 
[*]Mixed Seeds 
[/list][*][b]Opacity Percent[/b]: Adjust bubble transparency (1-100%)
[*][b]Size Percent[/b]: Adjust bubble size (1-100%)
[/list][size=5][b]
[center]Compatibility[/center][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Compatible with all major farming mods
[*]Works with modded sprinklers that use standard game mechanics
[*]Multiplayer compatible
[*]Safe to add/remove from existing saves
[/list]

[b]Enjoy efficient farming! [/b]
